name: Ennis
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Ennis, TX 2026: 3 Events
seo_description: Kids' Christmas in Ennis, TX: Lights of Ennis Parade and Block Party, Jingle, Jump and Putt, and The Best Christmas Pageant Ever at Ennis Public Theatre.
lede: The story of Christmas in Ennis starts with the railroad: the town was established in 1872 and named for Cornelius Ennis, a director of the Houston and Texas Central Railroad, and the Ennis Railroad and Cultural Heritage Museum opens its doors on Lights of Ennis night. In 2026 the Lights of Ennis Christmas Parade and Block Party fills downtown on December 3.
sections: Lights of Ennis, parade and block party

Downtown Ennis lights up on Thursday, December 3, 2026. The block party runs from 5 to 9 pm and the lighted parade starts at about 7 pm, with the Ennis High School Marching Band in lights, according to the Ennis Daily News. The Greater Ennis Chamber of Commerce and Downtown Ennis list photos with Santa at the Ennis Welcome Center, 201 NW Main Street, from 5:30 to 6:45 pm and 7:45 to 9 pm, live reindeer from 6 to 9 pm and a Railroad Museum open house from 5 to 8:30 pm. The parade and block party activities are free, the newspaper reports.
The railroad museum that gave Ennis its name

The City of Ennis says the town was established in 1872 and named after Cornelius Ennis, Director of the Houston and Texas Central Railroad. The Handbook of Texas adds that the railway reached the area in 1871. The Ennis Railroad and Cultural Heritage Museum, 105 NE Main Street, sits on the east side of the tracks in downtown. Inside are a short history video, railroad memorabilia, dioramas, depot replicas, a china exhibit from the old rail lines and Czech dolls from the old country. It is open Tuesday to Saturday 10 am to 4 pm and Sunday 1 to 4 pm; adults 13 to 59 pay $5, military and seniors $4 and children 12 and under are free.
Jingle, Jump and Putt and a pageant on Dallas Street

Two more Ennis events sit on Dallas Street. Ennis Jingle, Jump and Putt takes over North Plaza, 302 N Dallas Street, on Friday, December 18, 2026, from 5 to 8 pm, and the host lists admission as free. Ennis Public Theatre, 113 N Dallas Street, stages The Best Christmas Pageant Ever with evening shows on December 4, 5, 10, 11 and 12 and matinees on December 6, 12 and 13. Tickets are $16 for adults and $13 for seniors 65 and up, military and students, plus service charges. Doors open an hour before showtime, and seating starts 30 minutes before.
